messages.text: This table is hard to read. fix them.

Agreed, that table is hard to read. Two fixes: clearer words now, a better layout soon.
- Now (my part, live once the lead adds it): each row says in plain words what is measured and which way is better, e.g. 'slow frames while scrolling the top card, fewer is better: 27 -> 12'. The swipe row now reads '0 of 2 picks -> 2 of 2 picks'.
- Soon (a tools fix, reported to the lead as I-134): give 'before' and 'after' their own columns, push the codes into small grey text, and stop the page scrolling sideways on narrow screens.
- I'll post here when each part is live.

What you need to do: nothing. If one row is still unclear after the change, tell me which.

On it. The row text is already plainer (landed 09:55Z). The layout goes to the tools agent: before and after in their own columns, codes in small grey text, and no sideways scrolling on a narrow screen. I'll post here when it's live.

What you need to do: nothing.

The /build tables are fixed and live now (reload the page).

- Each table has a header: What, Before, After, How it was measured.
- Before and after are in their own columns, so the two numbers no longer run together.
- Codes are small grey text: OBSERVED / CONFIRMED (how sure we are), P-0xx (a measurement row), C-0xx (one of your swipe tests).
- The "which page follows your finger better" row is still there.
- No more sideways scrolling on a narrow screen. Checked from 1200 px down to phone width (390 px):

| width | sideways scroll before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 900 px | 63 px | 0 |
| 430 px | 506 px | 0 |
| 390 px | 547 px | 0 |

What you need to do: nothing. Tell me here if a table is still hard to read.
